fields.Name: IT186 - Agent Instances and Multi-Level Prototype Inheritance
fields.Description: Verifies 3-level BaseAgentID prototype inheritance, CodeGen hierarchy TVFs and vwAIAgents columns, live action/skill/instruction inheritance and child action veto, 2x2 RBAC privacy with Ancestor CanRun invariant and SQL RLS (UserAccessibleAIAgents), multi-instance primary uniqueness flip, ancestor policy ceiling intersection, sibling note memory isolation, and MJAIAgentEntityServer sandbox guards.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Multi-level BaseAgentID prototype inheritance, CodeGen hierarchy columns, 2x2 RBAC + Ancestor CanRun invariant, SQL RLS isolation, policy ceiling intersection, note isolation, and server sandbox guards all pass against live SQL Server.
